product_metadata.title: Nestl Kids Deep Pocket Twin XL Sheets - 3 Piece Bed Sheets with Fitted Sheet, Flat Sheet, Pillow Case - Extra Soft Bedsheet Set with Deep Pockets for Twin XL Size - Steel Blue
features: 3 PIECE BEDSHEETS: Luxury deep pocket sheet sets for twin xl include one 39 x 80 inch fitted sheet, one 66 x 102 inch flat sheet, and one 20 x 30 inch pillowcases with a modern 3-line design.
DEEP POCKET DESIGN: Suitable for depth of 14 - 16 inches, the deep pocket fitted sheet has a stretchable elastic lining to be ideal for use with memory foam toppers or pads.
UNBELIEVABLY SOFT: To achieve hotel-quality, our sheets are tightly woven using 1800 thread count fabric that is double brushed on both sides to be softer than Egyptian and cotton.
SUPERIOR FABRIC QUALITY: In addition to our sheets having a high thread count, silky fabric, and wrinkle-free to deliver a clean, freshly made bed look.
44 VIBRANT COLORS: Nestl twin xl size bed linens are available in steel blue as well as 43 other stunning colors

details.Special Feature: Deep Pockets, Elastic All Around, Lightweight & Breathable, Ultra Soft, Wrinkle Free, Double Brushed Microfiber, Secure, Snug Fit
details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Tumble dry on low
